title: ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.34960v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, and Audit checks whether the Lean proof follows it. translated_title: ProofLoom：面向研究级随机优化自动形式化的证明义务驱动理论构建
translated_abstract: 在Lean中对研究级随机优化进行形式化，既需要算法模型，也需要将基础库与收敛性证明相连接的领域理论。修改模型以恢复可证明性可能会改变原有的数学命题。我们提出了ProofLoom，一个用于证明义务驱动理论构建的全自动LLM智能体系统。给定已发表的算法、目标定理和源证明，ProofLoom能够自主构建Lean模型及配套理论。未闭合的证明义务驱动着定义、接口、引理和证明计划的开发。签名契约记录模型修订过程中的证据与义务；独立的Judge（裁判）模块拒绝无依据的假设和被削弱的结论。Planner（规划器）将已发表的论证展开为中间命题，Audit（审计）则检查Lean证明是否遵循该论证。在各项任务中，SOptLib积累了经验证的数学知识与构建经验：可复用的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ProofLoom提出了一个证明义务驱动的全自动LLM智能体系统，能从已发表的算法、定理和证明自主构建Lean形式化模型与配套理论，并通过独立裁判和审计机制确保形式化结果忠实于原始数学结论而不被削弱。
en_tdlr: ProofLoom introduces a fully automated LLM-agent system for proof-obligation-driven theory construction, which autonomously builds Lean models and supporting theory for research-level stochastic optimization while an independent Judge and Audit mechanism ensure fidelity to the original mathematical claims.
